description: Review a live public web page by its URL, no code needed. Rams opens the page at desktop (1440px) and phone (390px) widths, measures the rendered page and looks at both screenshots, then returns the top design issues (severity, category, where on the page, and a fix in plain words) with a 0-100 score. Use it when the user names a site or a page: "review rams.ai with Rams", "how does my landing page look?". It takes up to a minute and uses one review credit. Public pages only: no sign-in pages, localhost or private addresses. It returns no code patches. If the user has the code for the page, use quick_review or review_files on those files instead.

focus.description: Optional: what to put first, e.g. "mobile", "typography", "color"

url.description: The page to review, e.g. https://rams.ai or rams.ai/pricing

name: review_url

findings.description: Every finding, most severe first (the text shows the top 8)

measured.description: true = measured on the rendered page, false = seen in the screenshot

where.description: The element, when one element owns the finding

host.description: The page that was reviewed (host only)

score.description: 0-100, what a designer sees in the two screenshots; one critical caps it at 59

title: Rams page review
